scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@mp/api
scripts.dev:app: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@mp/app
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run web --workspace=@mp/app
scripts.db:inspect: node scripts/atlas.mjs schema inspect --env app --format "{{ sql . }}"
scripts.dev:doctor: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@mp/doctor
scripts.build:doctor: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@mp/doctor
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run deploy:api:staging && npm run build:hosting && firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging --only app,landing --expires 30d
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run deploy:api:prod && npm run build:hosting && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:api:both: npm run deploy:api:staging && npm run deploy:api:prod
scripts.deploy:app:staging: npm run build:hosting && firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging --only app --expires 30d
scripts.deploy:app:prod: npm run build:hosting && firebase deploy --only hosting:app
scripts.deploy:app:both: npm run deploy:app:staging && npm run deploy:app:prod
scripts.deploy:landing:staging: npm run build:hosting && firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging --only landing --expires 30d
scripts.deploy:landing:prod: npm run build:hosting && firebase deploy --only hosting:landing
scripts.deploy:landing:both: npm run deploy:landing:staging && npm run deploy:landing:prod
